title: Formula 1® Las Vegas Grand Prix™ streams live on Apple TV this weekend
summary: Formula 1® returns to the U.S. this weekend for the FORMULA 1® HEINEKEN LAS VEGAS GRAND PRIX™ 2026, streaming live on Apple TV.
body_markdown:
Text of this article


November 17, 2026


UPDATE


Formula 1® returns to the U.S. this weekend with the Las Vegas Grand Prix™, streaming live on Apple TV


Final U.S. race of the season to stream free on Apple TV for fans nationwide


Formula 1® returns to the U.S. this weekend for the FORMULA 1® HEINEKEN LAS VEGAS GRAND PRIX™ 2026 — streaming for free in the U.S. on Apple TV, with every session live and on demand.1


The lights shine bright on the Las Vegas Strip for the only night race in the United States. Mercedes’s Kimi Antonelli returns to the track for his second race since making history as F1’s youngest-ever Drivers’ Champion. With Mercedes having secured both the Drivers’ and Constructors’ championships, the team heads into the Las Vegas Grand Prix looking to continue its winning momentum, while the rest of the grid battle for crucial points and positions with just three races remaining in the season.


**The Ultimate Destination for F1 Fans in the U.S.**


Apple TV is the U.S. home of F1 — delivering comprehensive coverage and analysis, powerful and customizable viewing features, and seamless integration across the Apple ecosystem to Apple TV subscribers.


Las Vegas Grand Prix coverage will feature English and Spanish commentary and access to up to 30 additional live feeds across all sessions, including Driver Tracker for a bird’s-eye view of the race, session timing and data feeds, a mixed onboard feed that automatically switches between cameras as the action unfolds, and a Podium feed that dynamically follows the drivers running in P1, P2, and P3 throughout.2


Viewers can also get closer to the action with Multiview, a feature that brings together up to four live feeds on a single screen for a more engaging race-day experience. And now Multiview is available on supported smart TVs in addition to Apple devices and streaming players — so more fans than ever can follow every angle and won’t miss a moment.


**F1 on Apple TV Available in Dolby Atmos and Dolby Vision**


Fans can experience F1 on Apple TV in Dolby Atmos® and Dolby Vision®, bringing an even more immersive race-weekend experience to U.S. subscribers. Dolby Atmos surrounds fans with the sounds of race weekend, from team radio and commentary to roaring engines, on-track battles, and pit-lane intensity, while Dolby Vision offers rich colors and lifelike clarity. Together the two deliver exceptional sound and spectacular visuals that put fans at the heart of the action.


F1 in Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos is available through the Apple TV app on supported Apple devices and compatible Dolby-enabled TVs, soundbars, and home theater systems.


**Original F1 Programming on Apple TV**


Apple TV brings fans closer to the action with original programming, delivering fresh expert perspectives to race weekend and sharing deeper insights into the stories shaping F1 — from every curve, overtake, and podium.


*Circuits in Focus* — the dynamic track preview series featuring 2016 F1 world champion Nico Rosberg and content creator, record-breaking car builder, and driver Emelia Hartford — returns to Apple TV for the Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix. Ahead of race weekend, Rosberg and Hartford take viewers inside one of F1’s most distinctive street circuits, breaking down the technical challenges, race strategies, and split-second decisions that could shape the fight for the podium.


Using the 2026 Season Pack for EA SPORTS™ F1® 25, the official video game of the FIA Formula One World Championship™, Rosberg and Hartford put fans in the driver’s seat as they navigate the Las Vegas Strip Circuit’s long, high-speed straights; tight corners; and heavy braking zones. Along the way, they reveal the key overtaking opportunities and strategic challenges of racing through the streets of Las Vegas, where cool nighttime temperatures and the circuit’s low-grip street surface could make all the difference on race day.


Fans can also look forward to fresh editions of *The Fashion Circuit* , Apple TV’s social-first digital content series celebrating the intersection of fashion, culture, and Formula 1. With the Las Vegas Grand Prix on the horizon, the series will spotlight standout paddock looks and statement-making race-weekend fashion inspired by the glamour and electric energy of racing under the Las Vegas lights.


*Full Throttle* is back with an action-packed episode fueled by high-octane thrills, adventure, and unexpected twists. Led by content creator and engineer Christina Roki, whose infectious energy and passion for all things automotive set the pace, the episode takes viewers on an exhilarating off-road adventure, delivering a fresh and entertaining take on the world of cars and racing.


Fans can follow the race after it wraps with *The POV* , a social series that features former Red Bull Racing senior technician Calum Nicholas and Roki reacting to key moments from the weekend. Whether highlighting decisive overtakes, strategy calls, or unexpected turning points, the series’ coverage blends technical expertise with a fan-first perspective.


Together, these shows make it easy for audiences to engage with F1 on and off the track.


**More Ways to Watch the Las Vegas Grand Prix with Univision**


Univision will simulcast Apple TV’s broadcast of the Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix, with race coverage beginning at 10 p.m. ET, featuring dedicated pre- and post-race programming to bring the excitement of F1 to Spanish-speaking audiences across the U.S.


**Tubi Creator-Hosted Live Altcast**


Tubi Original *The Fast Lane* returns for its third and final live F1 altcast of the 2026 season, streaming free on Tubi for the Las Vegas Grand Prix. Hosted by YouTuber Michelle Khare ( *Challenge Accepted* ) and former racing champion and motorsports personality Justin Bell ( *Drive to Wynn* ), the creator-led altcast offers fans an alternative way to experience the high-stakes action of the Grand Prix on the iconic Las Vegas Strip Circuit. Featuring the main Apple TV race feed and onboard footage alongside real-time driver tracking and entertaining, culture-forward commentary, Tubi’s *The Fast Lane* closes out its inaugural season with a fresh, accessible viewing experience that complements the comprehensive live race coverage on Apple TV.


**Apple TV and Grindin Fuel Up Fans for F1 Race on the Las Vegas Strip**


Apple TV is teaming up with Grindin Coffee — the premium coffee brand created by hip-hop icons Pusha T and Pharrell Williams in collaboration with legendary Italian roaster Lavazza — to bring the energy, excitement, and culture of Formula 1 to the heart of the Las Vegas Strip. From Thursday, November 19, through Saturday, November 21, fans can enjoy a special Apple TV x Grindin menu of curated specialty coffee creations, served at Eataly Las Vegas at Park MGM from early in the morning until late at night. It’s a chance to fuel up and soak in the excitement of the Las Vegas Grand Prix as drivers take to the streets under the lights.


**Follow Race Weekend with Apple Sports**


Fans can keep up with their favorite teams and drivers all season long with the free[Apple Sports](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/apple-sports/id6446788829) app for iPhone. Designed for speed and simplicity, the app puts favorite leagues and teams front and center. F1 fans get real-time leaderboards, drivers’ and teams’ standings, and live updates for every qualifying, Sprint, and race session — all with quick access to the live race page on Apple TV.


With Live Activities,3 Apple Sports delivers real-time updates to the iPhone Lock Screen and Apple Watch so fans never miss a moment. Game Card Sharing lets fans share their excitement for any Grand Prix. Fans can also follow F1 across Apple TV, Apple Sports, and Apple News with My Sports, which syncs users’ favorites across supported apps.


**Get Ready for Race Weekend with Apple Fitness+**


In celebration of the Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix, Apple Fitness+ has created a special cycling workout led by trainer Kym Perfetto, inspired by The Warm-Up playlist curated by Valtteri Bottas, a driver for the Cadillac Formula 1® Team and an avid cyclist, on Apple Music. Set to songs selected by Valtteri, the high-energy ride will bring the excitement and intensity of race weekend to a user’s workout.


**Exclusive Playlists and DJ Mixes on Apple Music**


Apple Music subscribers can get into race-weekend mode for the Las Vegas Grand Prix with an exclusive new DJ mix from globally renowned DJ and record producer Martin Garrix. Ten-time Grand Prix winner Valtteri Bottas, who joined Cadillac for the team’s inaugural Formula 1 season, will also debut his personal driver playlist, giving listeners a glimpse into his musical tastes and the songs that fuel his passion on and off the track. Subscribers can explore Apple Music’s[curated collection](https://music.apple.com/us/multi-room/6759406123) celebrating the pinnacle of motorsport with more driver playlists, exclusive DJ mixes, and a refreshed[Formula 1: Sounds of the Circuit](https://music.apple.com/us/playlist/formula-1-sounds-of-the-circuit/pl.eb2ec5bff1b74b00829bfde13bc51c48) playlist that captures the energy of race weekend and beyond.


**Explore the Las Vegas Grand Prix with Apple Maps**


Immersive Grand Prix details return to Apple Maps in Vegas, enabling F1 fans to explore the race with a comprehensive circuit map showing turn numbers, the finish line, and race cars. Updates include realistic pavement coloring for the track, a refreshed 3D F1 pit building, and more colorful grandstands.


For fans attending in person, Maps makes it easy to get around the race, with useful information about entry gates, rideshare locations, water stations and other amenities, pedestrian walkways and overpasses, road closures, walking directions, and more. In collaboration with the Las Vegas Grand Prix organization, the[F1® Heineken Las Vegas Race Week Spots Hyperlocal Guide](https://www.apple.co/las-vegas-race-guide) will showcase places to visit near the circuit, along with fan zones, driver activations, and track features to help build excitement among race-week visitors.


**In-Depth Coverage and a Glimpse into Race Weekend with Apple News**


Fans can stay up to date on race weekend in Apple News with notifications and personalized coverage from leading publishers, and can track their favorite drivers and teams for live results, standings, and highlights. Users can also view the race directly within the News app through a special Las Vegas Grand Prix feature and easily jump to the Apple TV app for the full F1 streaming experience.


**How to Watch**


F1 on Apple TV is available in the U.S. on the Apple TV app on iPhone; iPad; Apple TV 4K; Apple Vision Pro; Mac; popular smart TVs from Samsung, LG, Sony, VIZIO, TCL, and others; Roku and Amazon Fire TV devices; Chromecast with Google TV; and PlayStation and Xbox gaming consoles; and at[tv.apple.com](https://tv.apple.com/us/channel/formula-1/tvs.sbd.241000) , for $14.99 per month with a seven-day free trial for new subscribers. For a limited time, eligible customers who purchase and activate a new iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, or Mac can[enjoy three months of Apple TV](https://www.apple.com/promo/pdf/EN_US_ATV+_Promo_TandCs.pdf) for free. Visit[apple.com/tvpr](https://www.apple.com/tv-pr/) and see the full list of[supported devices](https://support.apple.com/guide/tvapp/welcome/web) .


1. To watch F1 on Apple TV, viewers are required to have a U.S. Apple TV subscription. An Apple TV subscription does not include third-party branded subscription services or content available for rental or purchase in the Apple TV app.
2. P1, P2, and P3 are available only for race and Sprint sessions.
3. To get Live Activities, fans must be on compatible Apple devices running iOS 18 or later and watchOS 11 or later.
